as_told.title: Golden orb escorted by helicopters rising from behind Secret Mountain

plain: Ross Coulthart, who says he located a UFO base in Arizona, says he watched a giant golden orb rise from behind Secret Mountain at 1:30 in the morning, escorted by helicopters: "up comes this beautiful golden orb, gigantic. It pulses. It's plasmatic." He tells it as his own sighting, more than once on the show; in one version he calls the helicopters Black Hawks, dates it to 2025 and credits a woman named Melinda Leslie, and in another he leaves out the pulsing. If true, military helicopters were escorting something unknown out of a hidden site.
